exhibits.title: Brigham City Public Library
exhibits.description: Brigham City Public Library in Utah in the 1980's were my  first art exhibits. I showed oil, watercolor and acrylic paintings with a women's art  association in Ogden, Utah.

exhibits.title: Weber County Library in Ogden
exhibits.description: I had a one-woman show in the 1990's of my ephemera collection. It was a featured  article in the Standard Examiner newspaper,   including several photos. I also enjoyed a KSL radio interview about this show.

exhibits.title: Eccles Community Art Center in Ogden
exhibits.description: A newspaper article was printed about the classes I taught there at this same art center, I showed my work. I was accepted in about 7 or 8 juried  shows.

exhibits.title: The Painted Lady
exhibits.description: The Painted Lady Antique Store on the famous 25th Street,  now called Historic 25th Street, I sold my art in the 1990's (In  the 19-teens through the 1950's the Street was  famous for being the wildest street in the Western US. Al Capone was quoted as saying the street was too rough for him!)

exhibits.title: Artist's and Heirlooms
exhibits.description: In the early 2000's, I worked  and sold my art there. The Four Sisters Shop is also on this famous street, and I currently sell my ephemera collection (historical paper) there.

exhibits.title: Parks and Fairs
exhibits.description: Parks and Fairs in Ogden is held in the summer months; I did  shows and sold ephemera there for about 15 years.

exhibits.title: Grounds for Coffee
exhibits.description: Grounds for Coffee is an upscale coffee shop in Ogden where I had two one-woman shows and sold five paintings each time.

exhibits.title: Gallery 25
exhibits.description: Gallery 25 is a fine art gallery in Ogden. I was a  member there and sold my work in 2015

exhibits.title: Escondido Art Center
exhibits.description: I've been a member, and I have shown my  artwork since 2021.

exhibits.title: North County Art League
exhibits.description: North County Art League is the former Carlsbad-Oceanside Art  League, I am a member and have shown my art since 2020.

exhibits.title: North County Art League
exhibits.description: Brooks Sunshine Theatre is in Oceanside. I've shown my art there for several years.
